Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The King recognizes the leader or nominee of the party that wins the majority of seats in the National Assembly as the Prime Minister. Other Ministers are appointed from among National Assembly members by the King on advice of the Prime Minister.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Other Ministers are appointed from among _____ members by the King on advice of the Prime Minister
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The King recognizes the leader or nominee of the party that wins the majority of seats in the National Assembly as the Prime Minister. Other Ministers are appointed from among National Assembly members by the King on advice of the Prime Minister.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: There is a limit of two _____ from any one Dzongkhag
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Other Ministers are appointed from among National Assembly members by the King on advice of the Prime Minister. There is a limit of two Ministers from any one Dzongkhag.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The number of other _____ is determined by the number of Ministries required to provide efficient and good governance
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Other Ministers are appointed from among National Assembly members by the King on advice of the Prime Minister. There is a limit of two Ministers from any one Dzongkhag.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Chief Justice of Bhutan, _____ (Associate Justices) of the Supreme Court are appointed by the King
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Supreme Court of Bhutan, which comprises the Chief Justice and four Drangpons, is the highest appellate authority to entertain appeals against the judgments, orders, or decisions of the High Court in all matters. The Chief Justice of Bhutan, Drangpons (Associate Justices) of the Supreme Court are appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The term of office of the _____ of Bhutan is five years (or until attaining age 65)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Supreme Court of Bhutan, which comprises the Chief Justice and four Drangpons, is the highest appellate authority to entertain appeals against the judgments, orders, or decisions of the High Court in all matters. The Chief Justice of Bhutan, Drangpons (Associate Justices) of the Supreme Court are appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The term of office of the _____ and the Drangpons of the High Court is 10 years (or until attaining age 60)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Supreme Court of Bhutan, which comprises the Chief Justice and four Drangpons, is the highest appellate authority to entertain appeals against the judgments, orders, or decisions of the High Court in all matters. The Chief Justice of Bhutan, Drangpons (Associate Justices) of the Supreme Court are appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: That of the Drangpons of the _____ is ten years (or until attaining age 65)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Supreme Court is a court of record. The Chief Justice of Bhutan, Drangpons (Associate Justices) of the Supreme Court are appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Chief Justice and _____ of the High Court of Bhutan are appointed by the King
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The King appoints most of the upper Judicial branch: the Chief Justice of Bhutan and the Drangpons (Associate Justices) of the Supreme Court; the Chief Justice and Drangpons (Associate Justices) of the High Court.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The judges of the _____ and Dungkhag Courts are not appointed by the King
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The High Court of Bhutan, which comprises a Chief Justice and eight Drangpons, is the court of appeal from the Dzongkhag Courts and Tribunals in all matters and exercises original jurisdiction in matters not within the jurisdiction of the Dzongkhag Courts and Tribunals. The judges of the Dzongkhag and Dungkhag Courts are not appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Supreme Court and the _____ may issue such declarations, orders, directions or writs as may be appropriate in the circumstances of each case
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The High Court of Bhutan, which comprises a Chief Justice and eight Drangpons, is the court of appeal from the Dzongkhag Courts and Tribunals in all matters and exercises original jurisdiction in matters not within the jurisdiction of the Dzongkhag Courts and Tribunals. The Supreme Court and the High Court may issue such declarations, orders, directions or writs as may be appropriate in the circumstances of each case.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Parliament may, by law, establish impartial and independent _____ as well as Alternative Dispute Resolution centres
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Parliament may, by law, establish impartial and independent Administrative Tribunals as well as Alternative Dispute Resolution centres.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The King appoints the four members of the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: By command of the King and upon the recommendation of the National Judicial Commission, Drangpons of the Supreme Court and the High Court may be punished by censure and suspension for proven misbehaviour that does not deserve impeachment in the opinion of the Commission. The King appoints the four members of the National Judicial Commission.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Local Governments are entitled to levy, collect, and appropriate taxes, duties, tolls, and fees in accordance with procedures provided for by _____ by law
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Local Governments are entitled to levy, collect, and appropriate taxes, duties, tolls, and fees in accordance with procedures provided for by Parliament by law. Local Governments are also entitled to own assets and incur liabilities by borrowing on their own account subject to such limitations as may be provided for by Parliament by law.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Local Governments are also entitled to own assets and incur liabilities by borrowing on their own account subject to such limitations as may be provided for by _____ by law
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Local Governments are entitled to levy, collect, and appropriate taxes, duties, tolls, and fees in accordance with procedures provided for by Parliament by law. Local Governments are also entitled to own assets and incur liabilities by borrowing on their own account subject to such limitations as may be provided for by Parliament by law.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: There are 20 _____ (Districts) in all of Bhutan, each headed by a Dzongdag appointed by the King as the chief executive supported by civil servants
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: There are 20 Dzongkhags (Districts) in all of Bhutan, each headed by a Dzongdag appointed by the King as the chief executive supported by civil servants.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Each Dzongkhag is also represented by a _____ (District Council)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution divides Local Government into three tiers: Dzongkhag Tshogdu (District Council at the highest local level), Gewog Tshogde (County Committee at the intermediate local level) and Thromde Tshogde (Municipal Committee at the most local level). Each Dzongkhag is also represented by a Dzongkhag Tshogdu (District Council).

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Membership of the _____ depends on the number of Gewogs within the Dzongkhag
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Each Dzongkhag is also represented by a Dzongkhag Tshogdu (District Council). Membership of the Dzongkhag Tshogdu depends on the number of Gewogs within the Dzongkhag.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Each Gewog is represented on the _____ by two members, its Gup and Mangmi (below)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Each Dzongkhag is also represented by a Dzongkhag Tshogdu (District Council). Membership of the Dzongkhag Tshogdu depends on the number of Gewogs within the Dzongkhag.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Two further members of the _____ are one elected representative from the Dzongkhag Thromde (District municipality) and one elected representative from Dzongkhag Yenlag Thromde (satellite towns)
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Each Dzongkhag is also represented by a Dzongkhag Tshogdu (District Council). Membership of the Dzongkhag Tshogdu depends on the number of Gewogs within the Dzongkhag.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Dzongkhag Tshogdu elects a _____ from among its members and meets at least twice a year
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Dzongkhag Tshogdu elects a Chairperson from among its members and meets at least twice a year.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Dzongkhags are divided into _____ (Counties or Blocks), numbering 205 in all of Bhutan
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Dzongkhags are divided into Gewogs (Counties or Blocks), numbering 205 in all of Bhutan.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: These are in turn subdivided into _____ for election purposes
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: These are in turn subdivided into Chiwogs for election purposes. Other Tshogpas (Representatives) are directly elected by citizens of Chiwogs.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Each Gewog is represented by a _____ (County Committee), headed by a Gup (Head of Gewog) and a Mangmi (deputy), both of whom are directly elected by citizens
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Each Gewog is represented by a Gewog Tshogde (County Committee), headed by a Gup (Head of Gewog) and a Mangmi (deputy), both of whom are directly elected by citizens. The membership of each Gewog Tshogde must comprise between 7–10 members and meet at least three times annually.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The membership of each _____ must comprise between 7–10 members and meet at least three times annually
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Each Gewog is represented by a Gewog Tshogde (County Committee), headed by a Gup (Head of Gewog) and a Mangmi (deputy), both of whom are directly elected by citizens. The membership of each Gewog Tshogde must comprise between 7–10 members and meet at least three times annually.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Other Tshogpas (_____) are directly elected by citizens of Chiwogs
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Other Tshogpas (Representatives) are directly elected by citizens of Chiwogs.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: On the most local level, a _____ (Municipal Committee) is headed by a Thrompon (Mayor), who is directly elected by the voters of the Dzongkhag Thromde
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: On the most local level, a Thromde Tshogde (Municipal Committee) is headed by a Thrompon (Mayor), who is directly elected by the voters of the Dzongkhag Thromde. The other members of the Thromde Tshogde are elected directly by citizens divided into constituencies.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The other members of the _____ are elected directly by citizens divided into constituencies
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: On the most local level, a Thromde Tshogde (Municipal Committee) is headed by a Thrompon (Mayor), who is directly elected by the voters of the Dzongkhag Thromde. The other members of the Thromde Tshogde are elected directly by citizens divided into constituencies.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The powers and functions of the _____ are defined by Parliament
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: On the most local level, a Thromde Tshogde (Municipal Committee) is headed by a Thrompon (Mayor), who is directly elected by the voters of the Dzongkhag Thromde. The powers and functions of the Thrompon are defined by Parliament.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Like the _____, the Thromde Tshogde must comprise between 7–10 members and meet at least three times annually
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Like the Gewog Tshogde, the Thromde Tshogde must comprise between 7–10 members and meet at least three times annually.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution establishes a two-thirds quorum requirement in order to conduct any business on _____ levels
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution establishes a two-thirds quorum requirement in order to conduct any business on Local Government levels. Notably, candidates and members of the Local Governments are banned from political party affiliation.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It also defines local electoral procedure in terms of _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It also defines local electoral procedure in terms of Parliamentary Electoral Laws.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Notably, candidates and members of the _____ are banned from political party affiliation
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Notably, candidates and members of the Local Governments are banned from political party affiliation.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Two political parties are elected to the _____, established through a primary election in which all registered political parties may participate
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Two political parties are elected to the National Assembly, set up through a primary election in which all registered political parties may participate.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Political parties must be registered by the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Political parties must be registered by the Election Commission.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Registration requires their members to be _____ citizens and not otherwise disqualified, and that membership not be based on region, sex, language, religion or social origin
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Registration requires their members to be Bhutanese citizens and not otherwise disqualified, and that membership not be based on region, sex, language, religion or social origin.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Members of all parties must declare allegiance to the constitution and uphold the sovereignty, security, and unity of the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Members of all parties must declare allegiance to the constitution and uphold the sovereignty, security, and unity of the Kingdom.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Parties are prohibited from receiving any money or assistance other than those contributions made by its registered members, and the value of such contributions is regulated by the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Parties are prohibited from receiving any money or assistance other than those contributions made by its registered members, and the value of such contributions is regulated by the Election Commission.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Political parties may be dissolved only by declaration of the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Political parties may be dissolved only by declaration of the Supreme Court. If party objectives or activities are in contravention of the Constitution; if a party has received money or assistance from foreign sources; or if the Election Laws are violated, the Supreme Court may declare that party dissolved.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Furthermore, _____ may proscribe other laws with the effect of disqualifying political parties
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Furthermore, Parliament may proscribe other laws with the effect of disqualifying political parties. Parliament regulates the formation, functions, ethical standards, and intra-party organization of political parties and regularly audits their accounts to ensure compliance with law.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Disqualifications are adjudicated by the _____ on an election petition filed pursuant to law made by Parliament
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: In order to provide for informed choice by the voter, candidates for an elective office must file, along with a nomination, an affidavit declaring: the income and assets of candidates, spouses and dependent children; biographical data and educational qualifications; records of criminal convictions; and whether candidates are accused in a pending case for an offense punishable with imprisonment for more than one year and in which charges are framed or cognizance is taken by a court of law prio...

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It is also responsible for the delimitation of constituencies for election of the members of Parliament and _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The independent Election Commission is responsible for the preparation, maintenance, and periodical updating of electoral rolls, the election schedule, and the supervision, direction, control, and conduct of elections to Parliament and Local Governments, as well as holding of National Referendums, in a free and fair manner. It is also responsible for the delimitation of constituencies for election of the members of Parliament and Local Governments.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It functions in accordance with the _____ set forth by Parliament and is headed by the Chief Election Commissioner for a term of 5 years
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It functions in accordance with the Electoral Laws set forth by Parliament and is headed by the Chief Election Commissioner for a term of 5 years.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution codifies and explains the function of the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution codifies and explains the function of the Royal Audit Authority.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Audit Authority is tasked with auditing the accounts of all departments and offices of the _____, and wherever public funds are used including the police and defence forces
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It is also responsible for the delimitation of constituencies for election of the members of Parliament and Local Governments. The Audit Authority is tasked with auditing the accounts of all departments and offices of the Government, and wherever public funds are used including the police and defence forces.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Auditor General submits an annual report to the King, the _____ and Parliament
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Auditor General submits an annual report to the King, the Prime Minister and Parliament.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Royal Audit Authority functions in accordance with the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Royal Audit Authority functions in accordance with the Audit Act.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Its membership consists of one _____ and four other members, all appointed by the King
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Its membership consists of one Chairman and four other members, all appointed by the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It also comprises a _____ as the Government's central personnel agency
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It also comprises a Secretariat as the Government's central personnel agency.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It also provides that the _____ must operate under the Civil Service Act of Parliament
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Commission is charged with training, placing, and promoting quality civil servants within a transparent and accountable apparatus. It also provides that the Commission must operate under the Civil Service Act of Parliament.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution also codifies and explains the function of the Anti-_____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution also codifies and explains the function of the Anti-Corruption Commission.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It is headed by a _____ and comprises two members
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It is headed by a Chairperson and comprises two members.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The _____ reports to the King, the Prime Minister, and Parliament; prosecution on the basis of the findings of the Commission are undertaken by the Attorney General for adjudication by the courts
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It also provides that the Commission must operate under the Civil Service Act of Parliament. The Constitution also codifies and explains the function of the Anti-Corruption Commission.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Commission functions in accordance with Parliament's Anti-_____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Commission functions in accordance with Parliament's Anti-Corruption Act.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The King is the _____ in Chief of the Armed Forces and the Militia
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The King is the Supreme Commander in Chief of the Armed Forces and the Militia.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It establishes the _____ as responsible for the security of the King
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It establishes the Royal Body Guards as responsible for the security of the King.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: It also requires the _____ to be a professional standing army to defend against security threats
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: It also requires the Royal Bhutan Army to be a professional standing army to defend against security threats.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Royal Bhutan Police are trained under the Ministry of Home and _____ and are responsible for maintaining law and order and preventing crime
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Royal Bhutan Police are trained under the Ministry of Home and Cultural Affairs and are responsible for maintaining law and order and preventing crime.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution allows the _____ to use military force against foreign states only in self-defence or for the purpose of maintaining its security, territorial integrity and sovereignty
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution allows the Government to use military force against foreign states only in self-defence or for the purpose of maintaining its security, territorial integrity and sovereignty. The Attorney General functions as the legal aid and representative of the government and has the right to appear before any court.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: He is appointed by the King on the advice of the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: He is appointed by the King on the advice of the Prime Minister.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Attorney General has the authority to appear before _____ to express legal opinions and to institute, initiate, or withdraw any case
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Attorney General has the authority to appear before Parliament to express legal opinions and to institute, initiate, or withdraw any case.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Attorney General functions in accordance with the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Attorney General functions in accordance with the Attorney General Act.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution provides for a _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution provides for a Pay Commission. The Pay Commission operates independently, but its actions must be approved by the Lhengye Zhungtshog.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Pay Commission operates independently, but its actions must be approved by the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Pay Commission operates independently, but its actions must be approved by the Lhengye Zhungtshog.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Its Chairperson is appointed by the King on the advice of the _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Its Chairperson is appointed by the King on the advice of the Prime Minister.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Constitution places requirements on holders of _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Constitution places requirements on holders of Constitutional Offices.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Judicial appointees, and the _____ of Anti-Corruption, Civil Service, and Election Commissions are holders of Constitutional Office
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Judicial appointees, and the Chairs of Anti-Corruption, Civil Service, and Election Commissions are holders of Constitutional Office.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Article 32 sets forth the law regarding impeachment of _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Article 32 sets forth the law regarding impeachment of Government Officers.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Article 34 sets forth the guidelines for conducting a _____
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Article 34 sets forth the guidelines for conducting a National Referendum.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: Article 35 contains provisions regarding _____ and the authoritativeness of the Dzongkha version of the Constitution
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: Article 35 contains provisions regarding Constitutional Amendment and the authoritativeness of the Dzongkha version of the Constitution.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Second Schedule contains the National Anthem of Bhutan, referenced in Article _____ § 6
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Second Schedule contains the National Anthem of Bhutan, referenced in Article 1 § 6.

Constitution of Bhutan.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of Bhutan.question: The Second Schedule contains the _____ of Bhutan, referenced in Article 1 § 6
Constitution of Bhutan.fact: The Second Schedule contains the National Anthem of Bhutan, referenced in Article 1 § 6.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: The Dominican Republic has gone through 39 constitutions, more than any other country, since its independence in _____
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: The Dominican Republic has gone through 39 constitutions, more than any other country, since its independence in 1844.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: The current Constitution was promulgated on June 13, _____
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: The current Constitution was promulgated on June 13, 2015.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: Even the dictator _____ always operated under the banner of constitutionalism
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: Even the dictator Rafael Trujillo always operated under the banner of constitutionalism.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: Although promulgated as a new document, the _____ constitution was a continuation of the Trujillo constitution, and it was thus unpopular
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: Although promulgated as a new document, the 1962 constitution was a continuation of the Trujillo constitution, and it was thus unpopular.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: In _____, Juan Bosch's freely elected, social-democratic government drafted a new and far more liberal constitution
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: In 1964, Juan Bosch's freely elected, social-democratic government drafted a new and far more liberal constitution.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: These provisions frightened the more conservative elements in Dominican society, which banded together to oust Bosch and his constitution in September _____
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: These provisions frightened the more conservative elements in Dominican society, which banded together to oust Bosch and his constitution in September 1963. In the name of constitutionalism, Bosch and his followers launched a revolution in 1965, the objective of which was the restoration of the liberal 1963 constitution.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: Subsequently, the more conservative _____ constitution was restored
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: Subsequently, the more conservative 1962 constitution was restored.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: In the name of constitutionalism, Bosch and his followers launched a revolution in _____, the objective of which was the restoration of the liberal 1963 constitution
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: In the name of constitutionalism, Bosch and his followers launched a revolution in 1965, the objective of which was the restoration of the liberal 1963 constitution. Largely due to the United States military intervention of April 1965, the civil war had died down by 1966.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: Largely due to the United States military intervention of April _____, the civil war had died down by 1966
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: In the name of constitutionalism, Bosch and his followers launched a revolution in 1965, the objective of which was the restoration of the liberal 1963 constitution. Largely due to the United States military intervention of April 1965, the civil war had died down by 1966.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: The _____ Constitution incorporated a long list of basic rights and provided a strengthened legislature; however, it also gave extensive powers to the executive, including emergency powers
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: Largely due to the United States military intervention of April 1965, the civil war had died down by 1966. The 1966 Constitution incorporated a long list of basic rights and provided a strengthened legislature; however, it also gave extensive powers to the executive, including emergency powers.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: Later constitutions were enacted in _____ and 2002
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: Later constitutions were enacted in 1994 and 2002.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: A ban on same-sex marriage and abortion (Article 55) was included at the behest of the _____ and Evangelical Christians
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: A ban on same-sex marriage and abortion (Article 55) was included at the behest of the Roman Catholic Church and Evangelical Christians.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: As a result, the Dominican Republic has become the fifth jurisdiction in the world with a complete (no exceptions) ban on abortion (Malta, _____, Nicaragua, and Vatican City)
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: As a result, the Dominican Republic has become the fifth jurisdiction in the world with a complete (no exceptions) ban on abortion (Malta, El Salvador, Nicaragua, and Vatican City).

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: Since then, it has been held on the closest _____ to that date to ensure a three-day weekend
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: Since then, it has been held on the closest Monday to that date to ensure a three-day weekend.

Constitution of the Dominican Republic.subject: Women & Society
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.question: In _____, it fell on November 9
Constitution of the Dominican Republic.fact: In 2020, it fell on November 9.
